eraTaglines: The city as it stands today.
Green roofs, solar sheds and timber mid-rises replace the old blocks.
Supertalls and forest towers; the skyline doubles.
The sea rises. The port goes up on stilts, new districts float in the bay, and ground is broken for a spaceport beside the airfield.
Stepped arcologies and dome habitats; the first rockets lift off from Paine Spaceport.
Crystal spires and light columns; the city glows all night.
Forests take back the suburbs. What remains grows like trees.
Data monoliths and halo spires; a space elevator rises from the spaceport.

tips.label: Did you know?
tips.text: The city is named for Everett Colby, the 15-year-old son of investor Charles L. Colby.

tips.label: Did you know?
tips.text: The Boeing Everett Factory, on the north side of Paine Field, is the world's largest building by volume: about 472 million cubic feet.

tips.label: Did you know?
tips.text: Everett sits on Port Gardner Bay at the mouth of the Snohomish River, across from Whidbey Island.

tips.label: Tip
tips.text: Drag to orbit the city while it rebuilds. Scroll or pinch to zoom.

tips.label: How this works
tips.text: Every building is placed by the cartridge's EDHX director program, one tick at a time. The console only draws what it writes.

tips.label: Tip
tips.text: Press L to open the tape. Every build and rebuild the director emits is logged there.
